between_method_scope: paired effect_A - effect_B across the SAME base questions; descriptive only, no p-values or claims from significance differences
correction: R07: effective n, exact signs and explicit Holm families
direction: explicit - implicit; positive means explicit formulation scores higher
interpretation: No hypothesis confirmation, equivalence or robustness is established by these tables.
multiplicity_status: post-hoc analytical correction, not pre-registered; families selected after results were observed
sensitivity_multiplicity: same two families adjusted separately on grade2-eligible cohort; diagnostic sensitivity, not an additional confirmatory analysis
sign_test: exact two-sided Binomial(n_effective, 0.5); min(1, twice smaller inclusive tail); exact zero ties discarded
unit: one explicit-minus-implicit difference within each independent base question

upstream_metric_contract.correction: R01: global qrel IDCG independent of retrieved candidates

definitions.mrr: reciprocal rank of first grade-2 hit in top-k
definitions.ndcg: gain 2^grade-1; log2(rank+1); IDCG over ALL base qrels at k
definitions.no_grade2: legacy all-pairs Recall/MRR zero retained; separate grade2-eligible sensitivity
definitions.no_positive_gain: nDCG zero when global IDCG zero
definitions.precision: grade-2 hits / k, even if fewer than k retrieved
definitions.recall: grade-2 hits / all known grade-2 qrels for base

upstream_metric_contract.interpretation: Descriptive correction and sensitivity, not hypothesis confirmation.
upstream_metric_contract.qrel_scope: base-question union shared across formulations and methods; not variant-specific
upstream_metric_contract.unit: base question; mean of two formulations, then macro mean over base questions
upstream_metric_contract.unjudged_policy: unjudged run chunks scored as 0 by frozen convention; does not assert true irrelevance
